title: Consumer court orders Amazon, seller to pay customer ₹4.68 lakh for...
description: The District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission at Darjeeling recently directed Amazon and a seller who listing a camera on the online platform to pay ₹4.68 lakh compensation and refund to a customer who was denied a refund even after returning a wrongly delivered product [Soloman Lepcha v Amazon Seller Services Private Ltd. & Anr.].A comram of President Tikendra Narayan Pradhan and Member Bhawana Thakuri held Amazon and its seller liable for deficiency in service and unfair trade practi
